settings.title: How do I choose between G24 and G31?
settings.content: Start with the physical battery compartment and terminal layout. Both are 100Ah choices, but they use different case sizes. Confirm measurements before ordering.

settings.title: Does more Ah always mean more output?
settings.content: No. Stored energy and continuous output are different constraints. Compare both values, alongside system voltage, cables, fuse requirements and intended load.

settings.title: Which jump starter should I choose?
settings.content: Start with the supported vehicle and engine range listed on the product page, then compare portability, capacity, ports and emergency-light features.

settings.title: Can I buy home energy storage as an individual?
settings.content: Yes. Share your target capacity, inverter information and delivery location. We will help confirm a suitable configuration before an order is placed.

settings.title: Where can I find certification and test information?
settings.content: Relevant model-specific safety, transport and compliance information can be requested when you need it for a specific product.
